title: gentiana acuta subsp. plebeia
intro: Gentiana acuta subsp. plebeia, commonly known as Japanese gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate gastrointestinal issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Gentiana acuta subsp. plebeia include iridoids, such as gentiopicroside, and other compounds like amarogentin and swertiamarin, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
